Name: Jehoahaz, Son of Jehu
Summary: Jehoahaz, son of Jehu and king of Israel, was the father of Joash king of Israel, who defeated Amaziah of Judah.
KeyStory: Amaziah sent to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel, and Joash later took Amaziah at Beth-shemesh.
RelatedPeople: Joash, King of Israel; Jehu, Son of Nimshi
LifeLesson: A dynasty founded in judgment still passed its throne from father to son.
